decision: Restore host_terminate body. Its sole product caller terminate already authorizes on entry and calls host_applClose immediately before it. The executor and registry reject admission under their closing locks and drain before close returns. Keep the entry authorization in host_applClose for independent session escape/return callers. Keep the single init/close entitlement because cleanup needs initialized devices and the return path can close twice. All three review IDs retain residuals.
